evidence.text: The user said: "I usually pick the packages with Korean text since I can verify the ingredients directly without needing to trust the translated stickers."
The user said: "I keep a few emergency rations and water jugs stored in the garage in case I am unable to travel to the store."
The user said: "I've found that my system really needs a full twenty-four hours of low activity after any strenuous effort, otherwise I end up fatigued for several days."
The user said: "I usually keep a pretty broad mix of apps on my phone since I find myself constantly toggling between different tools for chat, schedules, and reading."
The user said: "I generally prefer cooking my own meals rather than eating out, mainly because I like controlling the ingredients."
The user said: "I've been wearing this smartwatch daily for the past year because it syncs well with my routine."
The user said: "I've gotten into a habit where I won't touch coffee after noon, and I usually wait until the evening to have anything alcoholic."
The user said: "I really make an effort to attend whenever there's a planned gathering, since being present is how I value the experience."

A reminder the user asked for stays scheduled until the user cancels it.
A preference the user stated applies to every later recommendation of the same kind.

updates.text: The user said: "I’m still getting used to this condo—it is much smaller than the house I used to live before."

The user said: "I’ve started taking on those month-long contract gigs where you live on-site—no visitors, no leaving the grounds unless there’s an emergency. It’s strange how quickly your world shrinks to whoever’s in the same building and whatever’s on the bulletin board."
The user said: "Ever since I switched to this simple analog wristwatch a few months ago, I’ve liked how it keeps me on time without any apps or charging."
The user said: "At the community center today, I relied on the live captions and a bilingual volunteer to follow the announcements, since I can only really make sense of the Roman alphabet now."

The user said: "Lately my phone’s been so much easier to manage—I’ve basically pared it down to just a handful of essentials I use every day, like one messenger, my calendar, and a single reading app."
